overview_description.description:
Sand is a multi-tenant, AI-based Platform-as-a-Service that acts as the connective tissue for energy data. Organizations that generate, distribute, trade, finance, or optimize energy today rely on a patchwork of point solutions and internal spreadsheets to run their operations — Sand replaces that fragmentation with a unified platform built on a shared data model and composable software packages.

Rather than selling a single application, Sand operates as a code factory: new energy-management apps can be composed rapidly from the same underlying platform, keeping the cost of solving a second or third operational problem near zero once a customer is on the platform. Sand currently powers three product lines built on this shared foundation — SandGen for renewable generators and asset operators, SandDist for energy distributors and utilities, and SandAgg for aggregators and virtual power plant (VPP) operators — each covering monitoring, analytics, billing, and operational workflows for its stakeholder.

Customers can also build their own applications on top of Sand's unified data model, extending the platform to needs no off-the-shelf vendor addresses.
